messages:
lucy: quick sync - proposing a controlled 'seed rotation' flow to rebalance flag cohorts w/out shocking infra. short bullets: preview, dry-run, staged apply, rollback.

rahul: 👍 must version seed + hash_version in ledger. api: {seed, hash_version, dry_run} and a preview endpoint returning pct_changed_by_geo.

emily: UI: show sample user ids (10k cap), token-cost delta, and an explicit "I understand reshuffle" checkbox.

fred: infra: staged apply needed (1% -> 10% -> 100%) to avoid cache churn. add cache warmup job and monitor redis miss-rate & p99.

ops-bot: note: creating task PLTF-533 seed-rotation-preview-api.

lucy: agree on constraints: block rotation if >5% recent churn, persist seed with config version, and make manual seed overrides require 2-step confirmation + audit. i'll draft RFC.

rahul: tests: deterministic mapping unit tests and a small sim for distribution + churn measurement.

emily: i'll mock UI for review tomorrow. thanks. :rocket:
